newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Mobutu son charged with attempted fraud in Belgium.
newsitem.headline: Mobutu son charged with attempted fraud in Belgium.

text.p: A son of ousted Zairean President Mobutu Sese Seko is being held in Belgium on charges of attempted fraud, the Brussels public prosecutor's office said on Tuesday.

Spokesman Jos Colpin told Reuters that Fangbi Mobutu Ndokula was accused of trying to swindle a Belgian company out of between three and four million Belgian francs ($84,300 - $112,400) with a false cheque.
Colpin said a Brussels court had accepted bail of more than three million francs but the prosecutor's office had appealed, effectively keeping Mobutu's son in custody.
"We found the amount of the bail to be too low...(we are) thinking of something like ten times as much," he said.

He said bail had been deposited from Morocco, where the ailing elder Mobutu is staying. He fled his country shortly before the capital Kinshasa fell to rebels led by Laurent Kabila, who is now president. Kabila has renamed the country the Democratic Republic of Congo.
Mobutu is to enter hospital soon in the northern Moroccan town of Tangier for chemotherapy treatment for prostate cancer.
